run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run of the migrate_imports script on a directory to preview import changes
run_migrate_imports_execute: run the migrate_imports script with --execute to apply import path replacements in Python and YAML files
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run the migrate_imports script on a single file to replace legacy fairchem import paths
review_replace_strings_in_file: review the replace_strings_in_file function that performs string replacements with dry run support
refactor_mapping: refactor the import path mapping dictionary to add new legacy to current module mappings
